children: China's manufacturing activity expanded at a faster clip in August, according to a private gauge, extending a growth streak to nine months--the longest period of expansion in five years.
The RatingDog general manufacturing purchasing managers index rose to 51.5 last month from 50.9 in July, data released by S&P Global showed Tuesday.
The reading outperformed the official gauge, which ticked up to 49.8 in August from 49.2 in July. The 50 mark separates expansion from contraction.
